name_reason: Game function with correct fd2_ prefix and accurate descriptor: scans all party characters for an item and reports presence. No Ghidra address residue. Matches purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Returns whether any character in the runtime party inventory holds a given item_id; used to gate plot-critical story branches (e.g. 天空之鑰 / item 100).
logic_summary: Loops char_idx = 0..15 (16 party characters). For each, calls fd2_find_inventory_slot_with_item(char_idx, item_id); on the first call returning != -1 (a found inventory slot) returns 1 immediately. If all 16 characters miss, returns -1.

params.name: item_id
params.semantics: Item ID to search for across all party characters' inventories (e.g. 0x64 = 天空之鑰). Passed unchanged to fd2_find_inventory_slot_with_item.
params.reason: Name accurately describes the value (an item ID) and matches how callers use it (fd2_any_char_has_item(100) for 天空之鑰). No address residue.

returns.semantics: 1 if at least one party character holds item_id; -1 if none do. Caller fd2_chapter_23_end tests == -1 (not found) vs else (found).

notes: Verified semantics against caller fd2_chapter_23_end @ 0x247be (uses == -1 = not found, else = recruit 卡里斯 when 天空之鑰/item 0x64 present) and FD2 KB (item 0x64 = 天空之鑰, 進入隱藏關物品). Callee fd2_find_inventory_slot_with_item takes uint32 params; passing int item_id through is a harmless implicit conversion (item IDs are small positive 0..0xD6) and not a logic concern.
